is a tower mostly based around debuffs. It throws a bomb at enemies, two at Level 4, which can be configured to apply one of the four debuffs it can apply to enemies. Most of these bombs also deal splash damage, which makes them able to deal damage to lead enemies. However, unlike most other splash towers, the
splash damage is always the same, regardless of how far away the enemy is from the center. Additionally, the
bombs do not ignore defense and can only hit five enemies.
The first is the fire bomb, which sets enemies on fire.

The second bomb is the ice bomb, which is unlocked at Level 2. It slows down enemies by 25% for 2 seconds, which stacks up to 25% and deals 20% of the fire bomb damage. From Level 3, it starts to reduce enemy
The third bomb is the poison bomb, unlocked at Level 3. It creates a puddle of acid, which damages enemies. The puddle lasts for 30 seconds. Additionally, it does not deal splash damage.

The fourth and final bomb is the confusion bomb, unlocked at Level 4. This bomb causes the enemies to walk towards the entrance for 2 seconds, with an 6-second cooldown before it can be reapplied on an enemy; however,
enemies will not be affected by the confusion. It deals no damage.

The confusion bomb will make enemies walk towards the entrance instead of the exit, with the distance depending on the enemy's speed. Because of this, faster enemies will be more affected by it than slower ones.
If a confused enemy reaches the entrance, it will change directions and move towards the exit, even if currently confused. Therefore,
with confusion bombs should not be placed next to the entrance, so that the confusion effect does not get wasted by this.
